scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const parts=fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>f.startsWith('source.part')).sort();const b64=parts.map(f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')).join('').replace(/\s+/g,'');fs.writeFileSync('source.tgz',Buffer.from(b64,'base64'));" && (gzip -dc source.tgz > source.tar || true) && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('source.tar');const magic=Buffer.from('ustar');let p=0;console.log('tar-bytes',b.length,'mod512',b.length%512);while((p=b.indexOf(magic,p))>=0){const h=p-257;const name=b.subarray(h,h+100).toString('utf8').replace(/\0.*$/,'');console.log('header',h,'mod512',((h%512)+512)%512,'name',JSON.stringify(name));p+=5;}" && exit 1
